text: dsh-ptc-diff-card 是面向 DSH Web 的界面插件，为 PTC 程序中嵌套调用的 edit 和 write 工具补上文件差异卡片。它在 tool.call.toolview 插槽注册自己的文件变更行，展示目标路径、输入大小和增删统计；展开后可查看差异内容，失败调用则显示错误输出。标准模式下的根调用也使用相同呈现。适合希望在 Web 会话中直接查看 PTC 文件修改细节的用户。需要将插件加入 DSH profile bundle；目标 DSH 版本为 0.2.1-rc.2 或更高。不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-ptc-diff-card is a DSH Web plugin that shows diff cards for edit and write calls inside PTC programs. Its tool view shows file paths and changes; expanded rows reveal diffs, and failed calls show output. It targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later and installs through a profile bundle.
想在 PTC 执行文件编辑时直接看到具体差异。
DSH 的 run_code 里面修改文件后，能不能显示增删内容？
Show me a readable file diff when an edit or write happens inside a PTC run.
dsh-ptc-diff-card 的功能「PTC 文件差异卡片」：为 PTC 内的 edit/write 调用渲染路径和文件差异，展开行可查看差异内容；失败调用显示原始输出。PTC 调用发生时自动呈现。

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · dsh-ptc-diff-card：[简体中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md)

DSH Web GUI 插件：让 **PTC 模式**下的 `edit`/`write` 显示和标准模式一样的 diff 卡片。

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · 解决什么问题：PTC（Programmatic Tool Calling）模式下，agent 在 `run_code` 程序里调用 `edit`/`write`。
这些调用被记录成嵌套的 `tool/ptc-dispatch` 事件，在 `run_code` 卡片下面渲染成通用行：
展开只有结果文本 `The file ... has been updated successfully`，没有 diff 卡片。

官方 Tool 层的 diff 推导在 `packages/client/ui-tool` 的 `diffCardModel` 里，第一行就把嵌套调用排除了：

```ts
if (block.parentCallId !== undefined) return null
```

而卡片需要的数据其实都在——嵌套块上有调用参数（`file_path`/`old_string`/`new_string`/`content`）
和落盘的 `meta.diffs`（已应用 hunks）。

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · 效果：- 嵌套的 `edit`/`write` 行变成标准文件卡片：标题、工作区相对路径、输入大小、`+新增 -删除`；
- 展开就是官方 `DiffBlock`：语言标签、换行/复制、路径行、增删着色、`⋯ 其余 N 行` 折叠；
- 失败的调用不画 diff，标题显示错误首行、展开是原始输出（与官方一致）；
- 根调用（标准模式）外观与官方逐字一致，因为整行是照官方实现的复刻。

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · 原理：在 `tool.call.toolview` 这个 keyed slot 上注册自己的 `edit`/`write` 视图，`priority: -1`
覆盖官方行（低优先级渲染），插件卸载自动还原。行本身复刻官方文件行（同一套
`DisclosureRow`/`DiffBlock` 原语 + 一份 vendor 的官方样式表），diff 推导沿用官方逻辑，
只去掉「根调用限定」：

| 调用状态 | diff 来源 |
|---|---|
| 成功 settle 且 `meta.diffs` 非空 | 记录的实际 hunks（路径回写成入参拼写） |
| `write` 新建 / 调用进行中 | 由入参推导的整文件 diff |
| 失败 / 中断 | 不画 diff |

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · 安装：作为普通 DSH bundle 挂到某个 profile：

```sh
dsh-ptc-diff-card README · 本地目录（开发）：dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:D:/dsh-plugins/dsh-ptc-diff-card
dsh-ptc-diff-card README · 从 GitHub：dsh plugin --profile <name> add "github:GrounzerLiu/dsh-ptc-diff-card"

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · 从 npm（已发布后）：dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-ptc-diff-card
```

然后把 `dsh-ptc-diff-card` 加进该 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，
重启应用生效。

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · 兼容性与边界：- 目标：DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`（`engines.dsh`），Web GUI（`platform: web`）。
- 只接管 `edit` 和 `write`；`str_replace_editor`/`apply_patch` 等未覆盖。
- 行样式是从 ui-tool 0.2.1-rc.3 vendor 的一份拷贝，应用大改版后如需同步外观要重新 vendor。
- 与同样以 `priority: -1` 抢占 `edit`/`write` 的插件（如 `dsh-diff-viewer`）不能共存：
  同 key 同优先级会被 DSH 拒。本插件会捕获并打日志，让官方行继续接管，不会让整个插件加载失败。
- 不自动展开 diff，行为与标准模式一致。

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · 开发：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check     # typecheck + 纯逻辑断言 + 构建
pnpm run build     # 只构建 lib/index.js 与 lib/client.js
```

`source` 结构：

```
src/index.ts                宿主半身：inert 的 Loader 入口（浏览器半身的挂载点）
src/client/index.tsx        slot 注册（edit/write，priority -1）
src/client/row.tsx          行组件（preparing / dispatched-settled 两态）
src/client/model.ts         行状态、路径、diff 推导

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · 开发：浏览器半身按 DSH 客户端插件格式打包：platform 模块表（`react`、`@deepseek-ai/cordis`、
`ui-slots`、`ui-primitives`…）保持 external，其余内联；CSS Modules 编译成哈希类名 +
一个 `<style data-plugin>`。

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · dsh-ptc-diff-card：[English](README.en.md) · [简体中文](README.md)

DSH Web GUI plugin: shows the standard diff card for `edit`/`write` tool calls made
inside PTC programs.

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · The problem：In PTC (Programmatic Tool Calling) mode the agent calls `edit`/`write` from inside a
`run_code` program. Those calls are recorded as nested `tool/ptc-dispatch` events and
rendered as generic rows under the `run_code` card: expanding one shows the result text
(`The file ... has been updated successfully`) instead of a diff card.

The shipped Tool layer derives its diff card in `packages/client/ui-tool`
(`diffCardModel`) and stops at root calls on its first line:

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · The problem：```ts
if (block.parentCallId !== undefined) return null
```

Everything the card needs is already on the nested block: the call arguments
(`file_path`/`old_string`/`new_string`/`content`) and the persisted `meta.diffs`.

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · How it works：The plugin registers its own `edit`/`write` views on the `tool.call.toolview` keyed slot at
`priority: -1`, which shadows the shipped rows while mounted and restores them on unload.
The row re-implements the stock file-mutation row chrome (same `DisclosureRow`/`DiffBlock`
primitives plus a vendored copy of the stock stylesheet) and reuses the stock diff
derivation minus the root-only guard:

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · How it works：| Call state | Diff source |
|---|---|
| settled success with non-empty `meta.diffs` | the recorded applied hunks (hunk paths rewritten to the caller's spelling) |
| `write` create / call still running | whole-file diff derived from the arguments |
| failed / interrupted | no diff |

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · Install：Mount it as a normal DSH bundle:

```sh
dsh-ptc-diff-card README · local directory (development)：dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:D:/dsh-plugins/dsh-ptc-diff-card
dsh-ptc-diff-card README · from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile <name> add "github:GrounzerLiu/dsh-ptc-diff-card"

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · from npm (once published)：dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-ptc-diff-card
```

Then add `dsh-ptc-diff-card` to that profile's `package.json` `dsh.profile.bundles` and
restart the app.

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · Compatibility and limits：- Targets DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (`engines.dsh`) on the Web GUI (`platform: web`).
- Takes over `edit` and `write` only; `str_replace_editor`/`apply_patch` are not covered.
- The row stylesheet is a vendored snapshot of ui-tool 0.2.1-rc.3 chrome; re-vendor after a
  major restyle.
- Cannot coexist with another plugin shadowing the same `edit`/`write` keys at
  `priority: -1` (e.g. `dsh-diff-viewer`): the slot rejects equal key + priority. This
  plugin catches that per key and logs, leaving the shipped row in charge instead of
  failing the whole plugin load.
- No auto-expand; behavior matches standard mode.

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check     # typecheck + pure derivation assertions + build
pnpm run build     # lib/index.js and lib/client.js only
```

```
src/index.ts                host half: inert Loader entry (mount point for the browser half)
src/client/index.tsx        slot registration (edit/write, priority -1)
src/client/row.tsx          the row component (preparing + dispatched/settled stages)
src/client/model.ts         row state, paths, and diff derivation

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · Development：The browser half is bundled with the DSH client-plugin wrapper
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`): the platform module table stays external,
everything else is inlined, and CSS Modules compile into a hashed class map plus one
`<style data-plugin>` tag.

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · Checks：`scripts/model-check.ts` pins the derivation's behavior without a browser: settled write
create, applied edit hunks with path rewriting, nested PTC dispatch (the case this plugin
exists for), failed edit, no-op edit, running call, preparing call, interrupted result,
windowed result with a null call head, and the path helpers.

dsh-ptc-diff-card README · Verification：See [VERIFY.md](VERIFY.md) (Chinese): how to boot a test profile, which row to look at in a
PTC session, and how to compare standard mode and failed calls.
